drafted_from: tool:google-account-list_drafts's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my Gmail drafts about the bakery order. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-list_drafts as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "Show my Gmail drafts about the bakery order." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-list_drafts, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"query":"subject:order"}.
3. Read what comes back: the request goes as GET  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/drafts?maxResults=50&q=subject%3Aorder (page_token is left out, so no pageToken is sent).
4. When the answer has a nextPageToken, run again with page_token set to it for the next 50.
